messages:
alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's tenant-overrides rollout, requests to /v1/convert for tenant=acme are coming through with duplicate query params and an extra X-Client-ID header. seeing both ?tenant=acme&tenant=acme and X-Client-ID twice in logs. not sure which rewrite is winning.
mira: ugh. can you paste the rule stack for that route? global vs tenant rules order matters.
daniel: 99% this is a 'append' vs 'set' semantics bug. if global rule appends tenant, and tenant override also appends, you get dups. same for header injection.
sushma: yep. we recently added a per-tenant rule to inject X-Client-ID for telemetry. global still adds a fallback X-Client-ID when missing. looks like both are firing.
alex: repro snippet:
```
GET /v1/convert?tenant=acme
-> proxy
log: query=(tenant=acme, tenant=acme)
headers: X-Client-ID: acme-client, X-Client-ID: acme-client
```
pat: iirc our rewrite DSL has three ops: append, set (overwrite), and ensure (only set if missing). default was append for backwards compat. that probably needs to change for tenant rules.
mira: two levers: 1) route matching specificity (tenant-specific route should be evaluated before global fallback) 2) operator semantics (make tenant injection 'set' or 'ensure')
daniel: ordering is tricky because we have dynamic route matching at the edge + cached compiled rules. if we change compile order we need to ensure cache invalidation across pods. also watch downstream CDNs — they might canonicalize query params differently.
sushma: proposal: for tenant overrides we should explicitly use 'set' semantics and update infra to prefer more-specific matchers. example rule yaml:
```
- match: path_prefix: /v1/convert
  when: tenant == "acme"
  rewrites:
    - header: X-Client-ID
      op: set
      value: "acme-client"
    - query: tenant
      op: set
      value: "acme"
- match: path_prefix: /v1/convert
  rewrites:
    - header: X-Client-ID
      op: ensure
      value: "global-client"
```
olivia: sounds right. also add meters for "rewrite-duplicate-detected" so we can alert if both append/set collide. want telemetry before a full rollback.
pat: Agree on metrics. Also suggest a small canary: route-level change on 5% of acme traffic, monitor duplicate counter and 4xx/5xx increase.
alex: can we also normalize path canonicalization here? we saw /v1/convert/ vs /v1/convert causing different rule attachments. would rather canonicalize trailing slash earlier in pipeline.
mira: yes move path normalization to preroute hook, before rule matching. that will reduce rule proliferation.
daniel: FYI if we change preroute, update compiled key for rule cache: include canonicalized path and tenant id (if used in match). otherwise stale matches possible.
sushma: action items:
- change tenant-inject to op=set (sushma)
- add "rewrite-duplicate-detected" meter + grafana panel (olivia)
- deploy canary at 5% for acme (pat)
- move trailing-slash normalization to preroute and bump rule cache key (daniel + mira)

alex: thanks — i'll patch the tenant rule and open a tiny PR. will tag everyone on the canary plan.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service v3.14.2 -> canary-1
pat: once PR is up i'll trigger canary deploy and watch the metric. :eyes:
olivia: will add dashboard panel and an alert (threshold: >1 duplicate/min for 5m) and share link in this thread.
alex: excellent. if anyone sees other tenants with similar dupes, ping here and we'll add a migration script to convert old append rules.
mira: noted. small reminder: doc the semantics change in the console UI for rewrite ops (append/set/ensure) so ops don't accidentally use append for ids.
alex: agreed — will add console tooltip copy.
